description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Galle Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Galle Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a council member, nomination of a replacement by the group leader, and the formal declaration of the new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations for local authority positions.
